pack.cell: 18650 Li-ion, 3.5 Ah, 8 A cont. (Samsung 35E / LG MJ1 class)
pack.config: 7S1P per cartridge, two cartridges (A and B)
pack.note: 24 V or higher requirement: 24.5 V (7S at 3.5 V/cell) .. 29.4 V

fet_sizing.note: two 650 V devices in parallel per outer channel; inner channel needs a 100 V class device only (clamp ~60 V)

inner_channel.note: inner band L is 7x smaller: equal turn-off time needs only ~1/20 of the clamp voltage

hot_swap.resistor_power_rating_W: >= 2 W pulse-rated (0.6 J per event, 5 s repeat)
hot_swap.contact_mate_sequence: PACK- (1.5 mm longer) -> PRECHARGE+ via 22 ohm (0.8 mm longer) -> PACK+ main -> ID/1-wire
hot_swap.swap_rule: the cartridge with the higher terminal voltage carries the load; the other idles through its OR-ing diode

wiring.vbat_pair: 2 x AWG16 (1.31 mm2) + 2 x AWG16 return, 0.9 m
wiring.coil_leads: 4 x AWG12 equivalent per band bundle, 0.15 m (driver can at the neck)
wiring.shield: overall braid, one-end grounded at the driver can

protection.cell_level: BMS 7S per cartridge: OVP 4.25 V/cell, UVP 2.8 V/cell (pack 19.6 V hard cut, soft warning 21.0 V), OCP 12 A (>2 s), SCP 40 A / 200 us, OTP 60 C, balance 60 mA
protection.cartridge_fuse: 5 A slow-blow, 32 V DC rated, in the PM1 board per cartridge path
protection.load_dump: TVS SMDJ33A on the OR-ed bus (stand-off 33 V, clamp 53 V), 1.5 kW 10/1000 us
protection.reverse: OR-ing Schottky diodes block reverse; contact keying prevents reverse insertion
protection.undervoltage_lockout: supervisor releases the TX driver only when the bus is between 21 V and 30 V
protection.tx_fault: hardware current limit (comparator, 30 A) removes the gate drive within 300 ns; MCU watchdog disables TX if pulses stop or timing is wrong
protection.thermal: NTC on the FET heat spreader (trip 90 C) and in each cartridge

shielding.conclusion: 35 um copper foil is an effective ELECTRIC-field/RF shield above ~1 MHz but gives almost no magnetic shielding at the 5-100 kHz pulse frequencies; isolation of the pulsed power stage therefore relies on distance, twisted/coaxial routing, local bulk capacitors, a closed current loop in the driver can, and keeping the analog board AB1 gate-blanked during TX edges
